answer:
Winnie has a total number of lollipops calculated as follows:
\[
45 \text{ (cherry)} + 116 \text{ (wintergreen)} + 4 \text{ (grape)} + 229 \text{ (shrimp cocktail)} = 394 \text{ lollipops}
\]

To determine how many lollipops Winnie keeps for herself, we need to divide the total number of lollipops by 11 (the number of friends) and find the remainder. 

Performing the division:
\[
394 \div 11 = 35 \text{ quotient with a remainder of } 9
\]

This is verified by:
\[
11 \times 35 = 385 \quad \text{and} \quad 394 - 385 = 9
\]

Thus, Winnie keeps \(\boxed{9}\) lollipops for herself.
